protocol.name: new_bank_v2_wearing_one_shot_calibration
protocol.source_fit: each subject's unshifted training native trials; source-only feature thresholds, StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1
protocol.prototype: one same-domain complete native calibration trial per class in source-scaled feature space
protocol.prototype_temperature: median source-training per-trial mean-squared distance to its source-class centroid, lower bounded at 1e-6
protocol.fusion: fixed 0.5 source logistic plus 0.5 softmax negative prototype mean-squared distances divided by source-only temperature
protocol.selection: no new arm or weight selection; compare fixed treatments on matched held-out native trials
protocol.endpoint: pooled macro-F1, log loss, Brier and minimum subject/domain macro-F1; paired corrected/new errors
protocol.boundary: public same-user wearing trial classification; only 0/1 shot per class is supportable per domain; not own-device or live recognition
